title: sponza atrium point-cloud
notes: Loads the canonical Sponza atrium glTF, traverses every mesh, samples 80k points weighted by surface area so columns/arches/floor are proportionally represented. Particles colored by their host material (sandstone-warm bias). 3.5s reveal: particles fly in from a distant cylindrical shell into the architecture. Orbit controls let user explore the columned hall.
